title: Procedural Graph / Reusable Asset Recipe Engine
objective: Implement a general deterministic DAG/node recipe layer for repeatable production tasks using the completed PCA-01 recipe/provenance/provider core, with typed nodes, parameters and seeds, dependency ordering, caching, preview/final modes, validation, partial recompute, batch variants, provenance, resource budgets and adapter-backed nodes without requiring Houdini or any single DCC/provider.

scope.purpose: Provide the reusable deterministic graph/recipe execution model consumed by later PCA production pipelines while preserving PCA-01 clean-room/provenance/provider contracts and all external owner authorities.
included: graph validation and fail-closed invalid states
scope.completion_gate: Representative asset-production graphs can be deterministically described, validated, ordered and evaluated/planned with stable receipts/cache identities, partial recompute and batch variants while preserving PCA-01 provenance/provider boundaries and failing closed on cycles, dangling references, invalid types/budgets or unauthorized provider behavior.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01 remains completed_verified and retains common recipe identity/version, clean-room provenance, rights/provider-adapter and prepared-adapter authority; PCA-02 composes rather than replaces it.
PCA-02 resource budgets are production-planning descriptors only and create no runtime quota, payment, procurement, provider or gameplay authority.

Provider-backed nodes consume validated PCA-01 prepared recipe documents; PCA-02 performs no credentials, network access, paid-service operation, public upload, data sharing, ARI registration or canonical mutation.
Production code was frozen after minimum GREEN 14173361721949fa5b6a164bc999a51796b1751b; all later application changes were governance/compliance/verifier proof only.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after exact-tree publication. PCA-02 enables multiple later PCA milestones, but no cross-program rotation or MCS start gate is newly satisfied; strict PCA execution order selects PCA-03.
PCA-03 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-04+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: PCA-02 is closed. PCA-03 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
